summary: Boulder Dash is a foundational digging/action-puzzle series built around collecting gems, avoiding falling rocks, and routing through caves, with both exact original-computer and modern anniversary routes.

entries.title: Boulder Dash
entries.definitive_edition: Boulder Dash 40th Anniversary for current access; original Atari/C64 route for exact historical capture

emulation.emulator: Atari/C64 emulator for secondary historical route
emulation.notes: Use the official anniversary release for current access; original hardware/emulation for exact history.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current anniversary build or original-computer route with exact platform documented

primary.version: Boulder Dash 40th Anniversary with original route documented separately
primary.why: Boulder Dash 40th Anniversary is the current official access route and includes classic/remastered material, modern presentation, and many new caves. For exact 1984 behavior, original Atari 8-bit/C64-style versions remain the historical fidelity route and should be labeled separately.
primary.how_to_play: Use Boulder Dash 40th Anniversary for current official access, or an original Atari 8-bit/C64 release for strict historical capture. Record route, version, visual mode, cave/level set, lives, controls, timer/speed, editor/custom cave state, and whether original hardware/emulation was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Exact original timing, visuals, and cave behavior
secondary.why: The anniversary route is current and convenient but is not identical to original-computer behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record visual mode and cave set; do not merge with Boulder Dash Deluxe or unrelated sequels without labels.
